anchors.label: ASSETTYPE
anchors.regex: (?:^|\|\s*)(?:Asset-Backed Securities|Common Stocks|Corporate Bonds|LLC Interests|Preferred Stocks|Senior Secured Loans|Warrants)(?:\s*\||$)

notes: Bundle identifiers contain asset type, industry, issuer/instrument/tranche, and sometimes reference rate, spread, coupon/rate text, PIK text, and maturity date.
Corporate Bonds, Net Assets, and Total Investments occur in bundle none_examples and are added conservatively so those identifiers receive signatures.
